claim: MAJOR DISCOVERY + FIX: the autonomous loop discovered that policy.json[detecting-insults] = haiku-all was STALE — it predated E019/E020/E026 (10 routings tested, only opus-everywhere works). Composite router was returning haiku-all (the stale policy entry) instead of opus-everywhere. Fixed policy.json by updating the entry to opus-4-8-all with rationale + evidence_refs to E019/E020/E026/E034. Composite router NOW returns opus-everywhere correctly without firing the LLM bridge — Static answered first, exactly as designed.

support.method: Direct python invocation of make_composite_router().route_async() — no cli.py run, $0 cost

after._rationale: E019/E020/E026 conclusively proved single/dual-role opus configs fail; only opus-everywhere $341.83 gold works.

loop_self_correction: The autonomous experiment loop's 'analyze results' step discovered a curated-layer (policy.json) drift from the evidence layer (E019/E020/E026). Without the loop, this drift would have silently shipped haiku-all to production on detecting tasks, producing invalid_submission ~100% of the time. The loop fixed the drift in the same cycle that discovered it.
scope: Major curated-layer correction + validation of CompositeRouter as production-safe routing strategy.
limitations: Did not run cli.py to confirm gold; the X205 baseline already establishes opus-everywhere gold on Phase 1.
Did not audit OTHER policy.json entries for similar drift — should sweep image-denoising-restoration, leaf-classification, etc. to confirm no other stale entries.

implications.E_PN8_status: completed_positive (policy fixed; composite returns correct routing)
implications.design_finding: (1) The Static layer (policy.json) is the source of truth for known tasks; curated-layer drift is real and must be guarded. (2) CompositeRouter is the production-safe strategy: Static handles known tasks deterministically, LLM only fires on unseen tasks. (3) The autonomous loop is a curated-layer-drift detector when run periodically.
implications.next_experiment: Sweep the rest of policy.json + task_memory/*.json for similar drifts. Tasks to spot-check: leaf-classification (E022/E023 baseline; family memory says opus-all; policy.json has no entry → fine; family default applies). denoising (E025 baseline; family memory says ???; check). nomad2018 (E029 baseline says mixed sonnet/haiku; family memory says sonnet-all from E003; family memory may need updating per E029 -68% finding).
